did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. A clothing job (a panjabi) went through every step on the real screens: price sent by the owner, checked and confirmed by the buyer, advance received, craftsman given the job, work started. Then the owner pressed Call for a trial and, after it, Trial finished.

checks.text: The owner's steps for clothing include Call for a trial next to It is ready; the job moved to the state trial
The buyer's job page changed to "Ready for a trial" and the history says "Ready for a trial." with the time
The owner's job then offered Trial finished and It is ready; Trial finished put the job back to being made, so the fitting is a step between making and ready
Starting work was refused until a craftsman had been given the job ("Give the job to a craftsman before the work starts")

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. The trial step is for clothing only (wood has no such button). The message to the buyer says Ready for a trial but does not give a time or place; that is left to the chat.
